description: Gasnetz Wilhelmshaven is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data show the complete gas network of Wilhelmshaven in each pressure stage. The data is continuously updated. The data can be viewed with the help of a plan information. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wilhelmshaven gas network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Niederdruck Gasnetz, Städtische Gasversorgung, Hochdruck Gasnetz, Gas, inspireidentifiziert, Mitteldruck Gasnetz. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
